notes:
SCENARIO: RAW storage of utm values (no downcase, no mapping) + no server-side value cap (D3). Cleanup + seed default-user-and-org.json ran clean. Verified via BOTH (c) the exact controller mass-assignment path replicated in test_frr (ActionController::Parameters -> same sign_up_params.permit -> merge(created_via:'created_via_signup', partner_source:nil) -> User.new -> save -> reload) AND (b) real HTTP POST /api/v1/sign_up (200) with DB reload. All values stored VERBATIM.

STEP2 mixed-case (controller-path, user.id=39352 AND HTTP user http-mixed): SENT utm_source='MixedCase_UTMSource_WWR' -> STORED 'MixedCase_UTMSource_WWR' (case preserved, NOT downcased). SENT utm_campaign='ProductHunt' -> STORED 'ProductHunt' (NOT mapped; get_created_via would map 'producthunt'->'created_via_product_hunt_ad' but utm_campaign is never routed through it, and the assert utm_campaign does not start_with 'created_via_' passed). SENT internal_ref='Ref_MixedCase_123' -> STORED 'Ref_MixedCase_123'. SENT utm_data={'utm_medium':'CPC_Upper','utm_source_dup':'ValueKept'} -> STORED identical Hash (jsonb string-key round-trip, class=Hash). created_via='created_via_signup' (the mapped enum column, confirming the deliberate contrast: created_via IS mapped, utm_* is NOT).

STEP2b from_omniauth (user.id=39353): partner_source 'WWR' -> STORED 'wwr' (downcased, per &.downcase in from_omniauth), while utm_source stayed 'MixedCase_UTMSource_WWR' and utm_campaign stayed 'ProductHunt' (raw). Direct proof partner_source is normalized but utm values are not.

STEP3 NO SERVER CAP (controller-path user + HTTP user http-big): SENT utm_source = 300-char string -> STORED utm_source.length = 300, STORED == SENT exactly (no truncation to 255). Schema columns utm_source/utm_campaign are plain t.string with NO limit: (db/schema.rb:1089-1090), so Postgres varchar is unlimited. This 300-char raw store is EXPECTED/CORRECT per D3 & Spec Risk 4 (255 cap is frontend-only, sanitizeTrackingParams) and is NOT flagged. Same HTTP user also confirmed absent params -> nil: utm_campaign=nil and utm_data=nil (NOT '' and NOT {}).

ENVIRONMENTAL (not a finding, not attribution): initial HTTP POSTs 500'd ('unhandled lowlevel error', 2ms, no User INSERT) because I included a 'name' JSON key; User has no name= setter (only `alias name full_name` reader at user.rb:250), so build_resource raised ActiveModel::UnknownAttributeError 'unknown attribute name for User'. A plain control POST with no utm params reproduced the identical 500, confirming it is unrelated to attribution; dropping 'name' (using first_name/last_name) made both HTTP POSTs return 200. Reported here only for transparency.

CONCLUSION: utm_source, utm_campaign, internal_ref, utm_data are all stored raw (case preserved, no enum mapping, jsonb string keys preserved); no server-side length cap; absent -> nil. Fully spec-compliant. No downcasing, mapping, or truncation observed => no HIGH.
